title: Contract Addenda to Group Room Blocks
content:
**A.1 Signed addendum required.** The contracted room nights of a definite Group Room Blocks contract change only through an addendum that the organiser signs. Guest services may issue the addendum, but it takes effect only once its status is signed, and each signed addendum is implemented once, by one block update and one ledger entry naming it. An addendum is issued pending signature, becomes signed once the organiser signs it, and is withdrawn if abandoned.

**A.2 Status of the block.** A block is amended only while its status is definite.

**A.3 Increases.** Added room nights are subject to the hotel's availability where the block type makes them so, and an increase addendum is issued only for rooms group sales has confirmed.

**A.4 Reduction deadline.** A reduction addendum must be signed no later than the block type's free-reduction deadline of calendar days before the block's arrival date. Days are counted as whole calendar days back from the arrival date; an addendum signed exactly the deadline number of days before arrival is accepted.

**A.5 Effect of a reduction.** A reduced block keeps its group rate, and the attrition commitment is then computed on the reduced contracted room nights.

**A.6 One implementation.** No addendum is implemented twice.

**Retired wording, kept for the record.**
- "A reduction is accepted only if all reductions signed for the block, including this one, total no more than the block type's free-reduction percentage of the room nights contracted at signing." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis for implementing reduction addenda.
- "Reductions beyond the allowance or after the deadline are not accepted; the shortfall is then settled under the attrition clause after the event." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis for implementing reduction addenda.

### Deadline on the calendar (hypothetical 60-day deadline)

| Reduction addendum signed | Against the deadline |
|---|---|
| 61 calendar days before arrival | within the deadline |
| exactly 60 calendar days before arrival | accepted, the boundary day included |
| 59 calendar days before arrival | after the deadline |

### Conditions for an addendum to change the contract

| Block status definite | Addendum status signed | Addendum already implemented | Contract changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes, by one block update and one ledger entry naming the addendum |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No; no addendum is implemented twice |
| Yes | pending signature or withdrawn | — | No |
| No | any | — | No; the block is not amended |

superseded_clauses: A reduction is accepted only if all reductions signed for the block, including this one, total no more than free_reduction_pct percent of the room nights contracted at signing.
Reductions beyond the allowance or after the deadline are not accepted; the shortfall is then settled under the attrition clause after the event.
